_comment: Registry of MCP servers the orchestrator connects to. Each entry is launched as a subprocess over stdio (the standard MCP local transport). Add a new platform by adding an entry here and dropping a server module in mcp_servers/.

servers.name: github
servers.description: Open PRs, assigned issues, and recent commit activity.

servers.name: gmail
servers.description: Unread priority mail: internships, college notices, deadlines.

servers.name: calendar
servers.description: Upcoming events, class schedule, exam and assignment deadlines.

servers.name: codeforces
servers.description: Upcoming rated contests and a practice reminder.

servers.name: classroom
servers.description: Pending assignments and announcements from Google Classroom.
